bootstrap.method: stratified cluster bootstrap over formulations within DoE iteration (Cameron-Gelbach-Miller 2008), paired resampling for Delta-C

claim_scope: Calibrated DIRECTIONAL-concordance attestation on Purformance HTE 2K-PUR lacquer scratch hardness only, within-study pairs, normalized feature domain [0,1]^4. AUDIT_ONLY. No batch-release, qualification, optimizer, product-performance, or FTO authority. Marginal (not family-conditional) intervals. Phase-1 would require independent wet-lab validation and a cross-formulator dataset.
decision_unit: within-study directional hypothesis (pairwise ordering of two formulations by scratch hardness, same DoE iteration)

declared_baseline.name: Rule 1 (Wicks-Jones-Pappas 2007): scratch hardness increases with crosslink density

honest_interpretation: On the module's STATED decision task -- directional ranking of within-study formulation pairs by scratch hardness -- the declared a-priori Rule-1 baseline (crosslink density alone) achieves concordance C=0.5623 (Kendall tau=0.1246). The literature-informed multi-feature scores reach: Guth-Gold physical C=0.7211, linear-4 C=0.7226, default HistGBM C=0.7237. The mission's falsifiable hypothesis is that eligible series improve directional decisions over the declared baseline: the paired cluster-bootstrap Delta-C(model - Rule1) CI is the test. Where that CI excludes 0 the improvement is calibrated-significant; where it includes 0 the multi-feature score is directionally indistinguishable from the single-rule baseline and the hypothesis is UNDERPOWERED/NOT-SUPPORTED on this dataset. The within-iteration label-shuffle collapses every model's concordance to ~0.5, confirming the ordering signal is not exchangeability leakage. Intervals are marginal, cluster-corrected, and grant no batch-release, qualification, optimizer, or product-performance authority.

metric.name: within-study pairwise concordance C = pairwise AUC (Hanley-McNeil 1982); Kendall tau = 2C-1 (Kendall 1938)

parent_guth_gold_receipt_note: Parent physical-baseline receipt scored POINT R^2 (magnitude); this receipt scores DIRECTIONAL concordance (the module's stated decision task).
split: leave-one-iteration-out (LOIO), 3 DoE iterations (n=17/27/42); pairs formed WITHIN held-out iteration only (group-safe)
theory_references: Cameron, Gelbach & Miller 2008 Rev. Econ. Stat. 90:414-427 (cluster bootstrap)
Wicks, Jones, Pappas 2007 Organic Coatings 3rd ed. Wiley Ch. 24 (Rule 1: hardness ~ crosslink density)
Guth & Gold 1938 Phys. Rev. 53:322; Guth 1945 J. Appl. Phys. 16:20-25 (filler reinforcement)
Flory 1953 Principles of Polymer Chemistry (network modulus ~ crosslink density)
